summary: CKGSB's global marketing team is executing a seven-month SEO/AI-search visibility strategy with Asia Star and Intelligent China as top priorities, while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and managing urgent email account lockouts.
summaryDetail: The team is driving a seven-month SEO/AI-search visibility strategy, with Asia Star and Intelligent China as the top two programs to promote, while US partnerships (Stanford, Columbia) are on hold and Berkeley is included in the audit phase. This week, the immediate focus is resolving Outlook account lockouts by updating passwords and re-logging in on all devices, and scheduling a 30-minute meeting to provide detailed feedback on the knowledge website redesign, which combines elements from both design versions. Joseph must share the HTML file of the design and draft the target areas/prompts and audience focus document, while the team analyzes Asia Star participant profiles and CRM hot leads and audits conversion tracking setup. Upcoming priorities include promoting spotlight videos of Andrea and Katya, sharing English case studies, attending the European Chamber Silver Economy event, and sending the SwissCham email regarding the 2026 Sino-Swiss Economic Forum, where CKGSB will participate as a free Knowledge Partner.
